notes: *so that no man may pass through* is divided by rule 48: מִן takes the complementizer, בְּלִי the negation present in the clause, and the participle the supplied *man* under rule 46.
מִפְּנֵי → *because of* is one fused unit headed on פָּנֶה (rule 30), and the bracketed assimilated article takes the written *the* (rules 12, 15).
*it be made* is given to הָיְתָה with *desolate* to שְׁמָמָה; the competing reading gives *made* to the noun.
